description: Static, manually-curated list of well-known Microsoft Entra identity endpoints that pre-empt Internet Access / Private Access / M365 traffic-forwarding evaluation. The Microsoft Entra system traffic profile is NOT exposed by Microsoft Graph (no `entra` value on `trafficForwardingType`, no dedicated resource). This file is a heuristic, not Graph-sourced data; update it if Microsoft adds/changes Entra identity endpoints. `pattern` supports an exact host or a `*.suffix` wildcard, same syntax as an FQDN filtering rule.
